saints.name: Faustinus and Jovita
saints.legacy: Courageous martyrs of the Christian faith
saints.summary: Faustinus and Jovita were brothers and martyrs from Brescia, Italy, who boldly preached Christianity during the persecution under Emperor Adrian. They faced severe trials, including being thrown to lions and enduring flames, yet remained unharmed through divine intervention. Ultimately, they were decapitated for their faith, and their legacy endures as the patrons of Brescia.
